commands: mysql -h "$DB_HOST" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" -D moodle -e "SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.firstname, u.lastname, u.suspended, u.deleted FROM mdl_user u INNER JOIN mdl_role_assignments ra ON u.id = ra.userid WHERE ra.roleid = 1 ORDER BY u.id;" 2>&1 | grep -v 'Warning'
echo '=== Users with Lambda in username or email ==='

mysql -h "$DB_HOST" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" -D moodle -e "SELECT id, username, email, firstname, lastname FROM mdl_user WHERE (username LIKE '%lambda%' OR email LIKE '%lambda%' OR firstname LIKE '%Lambda%' OR lastname LIKE '%Lambda%') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id;" 2>&1 | grep -v 'Warning'
echo '=== Site Admin IDs from config ==='
mysql -h "$DB_HOST" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" -D moodle -e "SELECT value FROM mdl_config WHERE name='siteadmins';" -s -N 2>&1 | grep -v 'Warning'
